samples.question: The image shows four equal panels labeled A, B, C, and D. Each panel contains one dark open stroke with the same width and endpoint span. Trace each stroke from either endpoint: a curvature reversal is present when the centerline bends consistently one way and then consistently the other way, producing one S-bend. Which labeled panel contains the only stroke with a curvature reversal? Ignore labels, location, color, and stroke length; inspect every panel and answer A, B, C, or D. A unique one-reversal score separates the correct panel from the runner-up.
